name: Memory Spiral

lore:
Pain—searing pain—filled every one of her senses.
The metal diving suit was no match for the pressure. Its shell buckled inward, and screws shot loose. Something crushed against her abdomen; something else pierced her arm. Cold seawater forced its way through the ruptured suit. Only the thickened metal helmet retained its shape, preserving a meager supply of oxygen.
Through the helmet's single peephole, she watched the water outside shift from azure to ink blue, then from ink blue to absolute black. Her breath fogged the glass. The roar of the whirlpool gradually faded, becoming little more than a phantom in her ears. Sensation slowly left her limbs, and each breath grew heavier than the last.

She assumed she had fainted from the cold, blood loss, or lack of oxygen. Any one of them would have been enough to cloud her consciousness. Yet she could not be certain. No matter how many times she blinked, all she saw was the same darkness.
This was a place beyond the reach of light—an uncharted domain in the deep sea.
A dull excitement finally stirred within her. An unknown realm. Her final adventure. Had she not dreamed of this moment all her life? She couldn't see anything, though...
 
Then she felt something strange around her ankle.
She instinctively looked down and saw something moving up her leg through the darkness. Was it some peculiar creature, colder than the sea itself?

How could she see its outline in such darkness?
It was black and writhing, like sludge...

<Italic:"What is this? Where am I? Who... am I?">
